sources.rationale: Remove the conditional obsolete stored Header.Relations requirement, now subsumed for every Atom by mandatory Header.Container. Retain Plan-to-Plan CONTAINS formal allowance and unrelated blocking rules; it is not an independent authored storage requirement.

Exclude Atom containment from carrier-derived logical parenthood; retain the existing non-Atom carrier-derived view and inverse behavior. The user decision supports the Atom carve-out, but the source does not settle whether every Artifact Revision and carried Atom are distinct graph identities, so the retained non-Atom boundary needs integration review.

one_open_issue: Does D264’s Artifact Revision denote an entity separate from a carried Atom, or can it denote that Atom itself? The answer determines the exact non-Atom boundary and prevents a physical nesting view from conflicting with the Atom’s logical Container.
constraints: No additional stored Atom containment fact or automatic inverse permission.
No native source, actual Draft, code, test, Workflow, Workbench or Git changes.
Existing Summary and metadata retained; verify same-ID scope under identity rules before adoption.
